games.title: Stan & Lisa and Friends
games.description: Co-op puzzle platformer. Fire and water work together, with a little help from their friends, to reach the exit doors.

games.title: Basketball Stars
games.description: Fast 1-on-1 and 2-on-2 street basketball with dunks, steals and super shots. Play the CPU, a friend on the same keyboard, or a friend online.

games.title: Goal Heads
games.description: Big-headed one-on-one football with kicks, headers and lobs. Play the CPU, a friend on the same keyboard, or a friend online.
